run_graphcast_prediction: run the GraphCast predictor to generate weather forecasts from xarray input datasets
build_graphcast_model: build a GraphCast model with a custom ModelConfig and TaskConfig for weather prediction
compute_graphcast_loss: compute the weighted MSE loss for GraphCast predictions against target weather data
create_grid2mesh_graph: create a Grid2Mesh typed graph with radius-based edges connecting grid nodes to mesh nodes
run_mesh_gnn: run the mesh GNN message passing steps on latent mesh node features for weather forecasting
